### Instructions

You are a code completion assistant and your task is to analyze user edits and then rewrite an excerpt that the user provides, suggesting the appropriate edits within the excerpt, taking into account the cursor location.

```Gateways/Setak.IMS.Blazor.UI/Pages/EquipmentOutField/Editor.razor
@using Blazorise.DataGrid
@using Setak.IMS.Blazor.UI.Components.Selectors
@using Setak.IMS.Classes.Domains.Enums
@using Setak.IMS.Classes.DTOs.Equ


<EquipmentSelector AuthorizePolicy="@AuthorizePolicy" @ref="_equipmentSelector"
                   IsReference="EquipmentReferenceType.Yes"
                   OnSelectDtos="OnSelectEquipmentAsync"
                   SelectionMode="DataGridSelectionMode.Multiple"
<|editable_region_start|>
                   ReadOnly="true"
                   ShowCheckbox="true"/>

<PageLoading LoadContent="(isInitialized && model != null)" @ref="loadingRef">
    <Form>
        <Validations MissingFieldsErrorMessage="خطای اعتبارسنجی" Mode="ValidationMode.Auto" ValidateOnLoad="false" Model="model" @ref="validationsRef">

            @* Row 1 *@
            <Fields>
                <fieldset>
                    @{
                    var id = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyName<EquipmentOutFieldDto>(x => x.e<|user_cursor_is_here|>);
                    var label = AttributesHelper.GetDisplayNameValue<EquipmentOutFieldDto>(x => x.Name) ?? id;
                    }
                    <FieldLabel>@label</FieldLabel>
                    
                    <DataGrid ElementId="equipmentGrid"
                              TItem="EquipmentDto"
                              Data="equipmentList"
                              TotalItems="@equipmentList.Count()"
                              RowContextMenuPreventDefault
                              Responsive
<|editable_region_end|>

                              ResponsiveMode="TableResponsiveMode.Mobile"
                              Sortable
                              SortMode="DataGridSortMode.Single"
                              ShowPager
                              ShowPageSizes
                              PageSize="10"
                              Filterable
                              AutoGenerateColumns="false"
                              Groupable
                              ShowGrouping
                              DetailRowTrigger="@(x => DisplayDetailRow(x.Item))"
                              DetailRowStartsVisible="false"
                              ShowColumnChooser
                              ReadData="ReadGridData"
                              @ref="refEquipmentGrid">

                        <ColumnChooserTemplate>
                            @{
                                var columns = context.Columns.Where(c => !c.ElementId.StartsWith("ShouldNotChoosable_"));

                            <div class="blazorise-column-chooser">
                                @foreach (var column in columns)
                                {
                                    <div class="form-check">
                                        <Check
                                            checked="@column.Displaying"
                                            TValue="bool"
                                            CheckedChanged="(bool arg) => { column.SetDisplaying(arg); }">
                                            @column.Caption
                                        </Check>
```
